the outbound logistics calculation is based on the distance travelled the weight carried and the method of transport. given that the prysmian data includes thousands of individual journeys making it difficult to extract the distances for each route the distance is estimated by grouping the journeys for each country and assuming that all journeys go from one capital city to another. in the case of journeys within the same country it is assumed that they go from the capital to the secondlargest city. in addition since no data was provided on the method of transport it was estimated that all journeys of less than km were made by road while all those of more than km were made by road and by sea journeys by air for logistical purposes are minimal. the emissions for each journey are then calculated by firstly determining the tonneskm multiplying the total distance travelled by the weight transported and then multiplying it by the applicable beisdefra emission factor.
